title: Kyber don release version 0.27
author: Jean-Baptiste Kempf
quote: We don release our version 0.27, wey carry three big update: clipboard wey we upgrade, openID connect, and media pipeline wey we don make sharp pass before, plus plenty small-small improvement.
html:
Kyber 0.27 don land!

Kyber 0.27 don comot.

Dis release na mainly for multi-client streaming: now, plenty pipo fit connect to di same host at di same time. Di web client sef don catch up for authentication matter with OIDC, e get live graph wey dey show latency, and both clients now dey allow you choose whether dem go reconnect by demsef.

See di main tins wey we bring.

Plenty pipo, one machine

Before before, one Kyber host dey serve only one client at a time. For 0.27, e go serve as many as you connect to am.

Di secret be say di host still dey capture and encode each display only once. Dat one stream na im e go duplicate come share give everybody wey dey watch, so di second or third pesin wey join no go cost di host almost anytin for GPU or CPU. If pesin join for middle, e go collect fresh keyframe as e enter, so picture go full im window sharp-sharp, instead make e dey see rubbish till di next keyframe show by imsef.

Dis one dey on by default. If you wan di old way back — one client, everybody else make dem no gree — set `multi_client = false` for di `[kycontroller]` section inside `kyber_config.toml`, and if second pesin try login, dem go pursue am with clear message instead make e just join quietly.

Two tins you suppose know before you depend on am. Di first client wey connect na im go decide di stream settings, so if anoda client come later ask for different codec or bitrate, na wetin di first one ask for e go collect. And di old RTP backend no dey work for shared mode.

Sign in with your company account (OIDC), for inside browser

0.26 bring OIDC come di desktop client and di server. 0.27 don carry am enter browser.

Choose OIDC as di authentication method, click Connect, and your identity provider go take over — Keycloak, Auth0, Authelia, or any oda one wey sabi di standard. By default, e go open for popup; if you comot di tick for di box, e go carry you go full-page redirect instead, wey go bring you back with all your settings as dem dey before, and e go connect by imsef. Di token dey renew imsef like one minute before e expire, so long session no go just cut for middle.

Where my latency dey really go?

“E be like say e dey slow” na complain wey hard to solve. Di web client fit answer am now.

On metrics before you connect, and di sidebar go show live graph of every stage wey frame dey pass, from wen di host capture am reach wen e show for your browser. On top of am, total latency figure dey wey dem divide into three: time wey e spend for server, time for network, and time for your own browser. If na di network number big pass, na your connection get wahala. If na di server number big pass, na di host encoder. If na di client number big pass, na your machine dey struggle to decode.

You fit on or off each stage by im own, and you fit pull di graph comot from di sidebar make e float on top di video. E dey off by default — dis one na tool to find wahala, no be sometin wey you need dey run every day.

Reconnection don be your choice now

E don tey wey both clients dey try again by demsef wen connection cut: ten attempts, one second between each, and di status go dey show which attempt e dey.

Na still di default be dat, and na still wetin you go want most of di time. Wetin new na say you fit off am now. Di desktop client dey accept `--auto-reconnect=false`, and di web client get Auto reconnect checkbox for di Connection section of di sidebar. For kiosk, demo screen or test wey script dey run, client wey dey try again quietly dey hide di real wahala — now e fit fail make everybody see.

Copy and paste with Linux hosts

0.26 give di Linux client im own half of clipboard support. Di host side no dey, so if you copy text for remote Linux desktop, notin go happen at all.

Dat gap don close. Ordinary text and HTML now dey travel both ways with X11 hosts, di same way e don dey work with Windows before. Administrators wey wan allow only one direction fit block di oda one for each host inside di configuration.

Controllers don dey work well again for Windows hosts

One change wey we do before make Kyber virtual gamepad dey report di real controller USB identifiers give di Windows host, because we tink say games go recognise am better. Dem no recognise am. DualSense go dey press button wey nobody press, and Xbox controllers wey new pass di 360 pad stop to work at all wen pesin connect from Linux desktop or from browser.

We don reverse dat change. Di host don dey see standard Xbox 360 pad or standard DualShock 4 again, wey everytin sabi.

Fixes to make am steady

kycontroller : Di host no dey force again say im configuration file must sidon near im own executable. `kycontroller --config /etc/kyber/kyber_config.toml` go point am to file directly. `KYBER_CONFIG` dey do di same tin through di environment, and di first process wey find am go pass di full path down, so di controller, di capture server and di input server go all read di same file instead make each one dey find im own. `KYBER_LOG_DIR` dey put logs for place wey dem fit write. And one new `webclient` setting dey serve di browser client from any folder wey you choose. If you type path wrong, Kyber go stop with error now instead make e just start quietly with default settings — wey before before, e go just look like “dem dey ignore my configuration”.

kyservice : For Windows, di background service wey dey launch di host enter your desktop session dey give Windows pointer to memory wey e don already release. Di sign na say sometimes di host go just fail to start after boot or after service restart, and notin clear go show wetin cause am. We don fix am.

kyclient : Before, di client go keep im window open dey “wait for reconnection” even after e don already give up to try again, and you go just dey look one last frame wey don freeze and no go ever come back. Now e go close wen session don really end, and e go report real retries as retries.

libkypc : Helper processes now dey die as soon as di host drop dia handle. Capture processes wey no get owner but still hold di display and di GPU encoder after session don end suppose don be tin of di past.

Upgrade

Kyber 0.27 don ready now.

Go di downloads page to collect di latest version, or pull di updated packages through di normal way wey you dey use.

We dey welcome your feedback and bug reports for our Discord space .
